legenda_completa: GTA VICE CITY vs GTA 6! 🌴 The evolution of Vice City is INSANE! Remember walking around the Ocean View Hotel in the original GTA Vice City? Now compare it with GTA 6! From walking in front of the iconic Ocean View Hotel to taking the classic yellow Oceanic for a ride (Vapid Stanier '55 in GTA 6), and exploring the beautiful beaches, this comparison shows just how much Vice City has evolved!
